name: example_order_regions
sql: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM orders ORDER BY region

name: example_orders_summary
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE (:region = '__all__' OR region = :region) AND LOWER(customer) LIKE '%' || LOWER(:search) || '%'

name: example_orders_page
sql: SELECT order_id, placed_on, customer, region, amount FROM orders WHERE (:region = '__all__' OR region = :region) AND LOWER(customer) LIKE '%' || LOWER(:search) || '%' ORDER BY placed_on DESC, order_id LIMIT 50 OFFSET :offset
